scratch_owner: PrepareFrameOwnerProbe; parent owns execution and removal of this exact scratch directory
parent_intake_correction: Before measurement, select the exact matching staged-source integration flake, not the differing canonical checkout. Preserve prepared SHA256 checksums as historical; bind execution inputs and binary using BLAKE3.
toolchain: nightly-2026-05-26; actual rustc/cargo -vV and source-input BLAKE3 recorded by driver
profile: release-optimized cfg(test) native loopback diagnostic; existing fixture profile and protocol unchanged
features: manifest defaults, no added feature or dependency
size_schedule: each round both sizes; typical then max on even rounds, max then typical on odd rounds
typical_scope: explicit assumed typical workload, not a claim of production traffic representativeness
maximum_derivation: unchanged fixture profile, protocol framing and endpoint resources all admit 4096 bytes; OpenStream credit 4096; inflight budget 8192 and queue budget 16384 do not lower it
payload_pattern: byte[index] = index % 251; fresh canonical owner and listener per operation

resources.network: fresh task-owned user+network namespace, only loopback enabled, existing Minimal Iroh preset with relay disabled and explicit IPv4 loopback binds
resources.concurrency: one exchange at a time; no source patches or upstream effects

measurement.owner_held_ns: sum of external register and route call durations including local destructors, not a sum of stage timers
measurement.whole_operation_ns: external elapsed from immediately before register to immediately after route, excludes fixture setup, canonical oracle, server join and serialization
measurement.register_body_and_route_body_ns: near-return internal spans, not used as full-owner denominators
measurement.stage_ns: validation pre/post hash, admission frame_ref, payload copy, submit transition, input copy, thread dispatch, runtime build, real block_on exchange, runtime shutdown, evidence clone+match, acknowledgement transition, client/server shell frame_ref
measurement.overhead: Instant calls and shared collector Mutex writes perturb instrumented operations and are included in external owner time. No timing subtraction or overhead de-bias is authorized. Timers do not emit I/O in owner path. Stage spans are nested, not additive. Server-side hash is concurrent and cannot be summed as owner CPU.
measurement.canonical_checks: actual ACK transition ref and final TransportState equal direct canonical reference SendFrame then AcknowledgeFrame; reference pending/ack deliveries checked Pending/Delivered; actual client and listener Delivered evidence have request-bound payload/ACK refs, exact byte count, zero retries; inflight zero; listener cleanup Clean
measurement.output: 46 JSONL rows on successful completion, including 6 warmups and 40 measured rows; no success summary on partial/failing run

predeclared_decision.threshold: strictly greater than 0.10 at BOTH sizes: sum(register_hash_ns)/sum(owner_held_ns) over measured successful canonical-checked Delivered operations
predeclared_decision.required_baseline: production-representative runtime reuse/amortization with preserved canonical transitions, receipts and frame_ref; review and record that baseline identity before measuring it
predeclared_decision.current_missing_capability: Registered::route_effect invokes private run_exchange; run_exchange always spawns a thread and creates/drops Tokio Runtime per frame; no injected runtime or reuse/amortization API exists on this path
predeclared_decision.prerequisite_policy: do not silently redesign runtime ownership or subtract measured runtime creation/shutdown from current-path results as a substitute
predeclared_decision.adoption: NEVER adopt begin/commit from this diagnostic fixture profile, even if measured fraction exceeds 0.10; production baseline and canonical behavior qualification are separate prerequisites

cleanup_owner: Transport maintainers own the retained evidence; task-owned scratch can be removed after private source retention.
